author: freeCodeCamp.org
description: When you're learning a new skill, you've gotta be consistent for long enough to make a difference. Then you'll see real improvements and advancements in your abilities. Zubin discusses this with Quincy - through the lens of learning to play guitar - on the freeCodeCamp podcast.
title: When you're learning a new skill, you've gotta be consistent for long enough to make a difference
